questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions coming up ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is eight-sided and is the only sign with this shape on roads. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go forward until the way is clear and you can safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has multiple curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be prepared to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always allow pedestrians to cross safely. Pay attention to pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked line. Stop before the crosswalk if there is no line. Stop before the intersection if there is no crosswalk. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. It is illegal to turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn you of hazards ahead. They are yellow or orange in color.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any vehicles or pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane under it does not continue on the freeway. If you stay in this lane, you will exit. You can change lanes to avoid exiting, or you must exit if you stay in that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction zones ahead. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill going downward is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you traffic laws. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers to be careful when roads are wet. Wet pavement becomes slippery and harder to drive on safely. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one lane. You must merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down and adjust your driving to safely follow the curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must obey it. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles. Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road ahead may become slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance on an overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to school zones. This sign warns you that children or pedestrians may be crossing nearby.
